players.product: Inference-first GPU-as-a-Service cloud on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs deployed in colocation sites; NVIDIA Cloud Partner

quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q customer concentration (customers not named): four customers accounted for 90% of Q2 2026 revenue - Customer B 36%, Customer D 35%, Customer E 10%, Customer A 9% (Q2 2025: three customers 84%, Customer A 35%, B 38%, C 11%); for H1 2026 four customers accounted for 86%.

10-Q contracts and backlog: of the $173,107,691 of remaining performance obligations on direct-to-customer compute power contracts at June 30, 2026 (the backlog related to these contracts), $34,368,785 will be recognized as revenue during 2026 and the remainder between 2027 and 2029. Customer contracts in the 10-Q (customers not named): May 28, 2026 - 32 bare metal clustered NVIDIA B200 GPU nodes, three-year term, aggregate contracted fees of approximately $19.8 million (upfront payment approximately $4.9 million); June 29, 2026 - 32 B300 nodes, two-year term, approximately $18.0 million (upfront approximately $3.7 million); July 22, 2026 - 56 B300 nodes, two-year term, approximately $32.0 million (upfront approximately $6.5 million); July 25, 2026 - 16 B200 nodes and 64 B300 nodes, three-year term, approximately $72.0 million (upfront approximately $14.4 million). The 10-Q also says QumulusAI entered into multiple significant revenue contracts in July 2026 for approximately $103,900,000 in future revenue, for which it received approximately $20,900,000 in cash deposits.
quarterly_data.figure: $34,368,785 of RPO recognized in 2026; July 2026 contracts approximately $103,900,000 of future revenue

quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q build-out: combined deployed and contracted capacity is approximately 8 MW across colocation data centers in Marietta, Kansas City, Denver and Philadelphia. Deposits for power equipment (prepayments to suppliers and manufacturers for compute power and related equipment) reached $26,022,880 at June 30, 2026 versus $13,622,641 at December 31, 2025; H1 2026 purchases of property and equipment were $36,824,254 and right-of-use assets of $45,504,172 were acquired in exchange for lease obligations. Q2 colocation costs were $1,547,350 (+500%); HPC segment depreciation and amortization was $6,682,359 in Q2.
quarterly_data.figure: power equipment deposits $26,022,880; H1 2026 property and equipment purchases $36,824,254
